title.zh: PCIe 为什么能一代一代翻倍

desc.zh: 显卡、固态、网卡都插在 PCIe 上。这条总线二十多年里速度翻了六次，靠的是什么？一次读写在线上到底发生了什么？十个可以拖动的模型：链路协商、TLP 包头、信用流控、ACK/NAK 重发、开机枚举、MSI 中断、走线损耗、PAM4 眼图、FEC 和 FLIT。
desc.en: Graphics cards, SSDs and network cards all plug into PCIe. Its speed has doubled six times in over twenty years: how, and what actually happens on the wire during one read or write? Ten models you can drag: link negotiation, TLP headers, credit flow control, ACK/NAK replay, enumeration, MSI interrupts, trace loss, PAM4 eyes, FEC and FLITs.

title.zh: PCIe 的拓扑：根复合体、交换芯片和端点组成的树
title.en: PCIe Topology: a Tree of Root Complex, Switches and Endpoints

desc.zh: PCIe 没有共享总线：每台设备一条点对点链路，所有链路连成根在 CPU 里的树。
desc.en: PCIe has no shared bus: each device gets its own point-to-point link, and the links form a tree rooted in the CPU.

zh: PCIe 是怎么连接设备的

title.zh: PCIe 通道与代：x16、x4 和每代的速率
title.en: PCIe Lanes and Generations: x16, x4 and the Rate of Each Generation

desc.zh: 一条通道是两对差分线；每代靠提符号率、换编码或换调制翻倍；链路两头取共同的最高代和宽度。
desc.en: A lane is two differential pairs; each generation doubled by raising the symbol rate, changing the encoding or changing the modulation; both ends settle on the highest common generation and width.

zh: 显卡插 x8 会慢吗

title.en: TLPs: the Packets and Headers of PCIe

desc.zh: 读是请求加完成包，写只发不等；包头的每一位、MPS 和 MRRS 怎样决定效率。
desc.en: A read is a request plus completions, a write is posted; every bit of the header, and how MPS and MRRS set the efficiency.

desc.zh: 接收方先报缓冲，发送方花一点记一点；信用盖不住往返时链路跑不满。
desc.en: The receiver advertises its buffers and the sender spends them; when credits cannot cover the round trip the link idles.

en: why PCIe does not drop packets

desc.zh: 序号、LCRC 和回退 N 帧：误码率怎样变成有效带宽的损失。
desc.en: Sequence numbers, LCRC and go-back-N: how a bit-error rate turns into lost bandwidth.

title.zh: 开机枚举、配置空间与 BAR

desc.zh: 深度优先给总线编号，写全 1 读回量出 BAR 大小，再按 1 MiB 粒度分窗口；ECAM 怎样把配置空间映射成内存。
desc.en: Depth-first bus numbering, sizing BARs by writing all ones, 1 MiB bridge windows, and how ECAM maps configuration space into memory.

zh: 总线号 设备号 功能号

title.zh: DMA 与 MSI：中断也是一次写内存
title.en: DMA and MSI: an Interrupt Is a Memory Write

desc.zh: 门铃、DMA、IOMMU，以及 x86 上 MSI 地址和数据的每一位。
desc.en: Doorbells, DMA, the IOMMU, and every bit of an x86 MSI address and data word.

title.zh: 通道损耗预算与重定时器

desc.zh: 每代的损耗预算怎样分给封装、插槽、插卡和走线，板材和重定时器决定能走多远。
desc.en: How each generation's loss budget is split between package, slot, card and trace, and how board material and retimers set the reach.

desc.zh: 四个电平、一个符号两比特，眼高只剩三分之一；为什么 PCIe 6.0 选 PAM4 而不翻倍频率。
desc.en: Four levels and two bits per symbol leave eyes a third as tall; why PCIe 6.0 chose PAM4 over doubling the frequency.

title.en: FLIT Mode and Forward Error Correction

desc.zh: 256 字节的 FLIT、三路交织 FEC 和 CRC；FLIT 对小包和大包的延迟与带宽。
desc.en: The 256-byte FLIT with three-way interleaved FEC and CRC; what FLIT mode does to latency and bandwidth for small and large packets.

title.zh: PCIe 7.0、8.0 与合规测试的进展

desc.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月：7.0 已发布，8.0 草案，6.x 合规测试开始，按已定、已做出、声称三类分开。
desc.en: As of November 2026: 7.0 released, 8.0 in draft, 6.x compliance testing under way, kept apart as established, demonstrated and claimed.

desc.zh: 提符号率、换编码、换调制，以及每一招在物理上付的账。
desc.en: Raising the symbol rate, changing the encoding, changing the modulation, and the physical bill each one ran up.
